name: Palworld
description: Palworld dedicated server. The game port is UDP and is 8211 by convention. The server name, passwords and player limit below are written to Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/PalWorldSettings.ini before every start; every other setting in that file is yours to edit. Palworld has no console of its own, so console input is sent over RCON and 'stop' saves the world first.
startup_command: export ADMIN_PASSWORD="${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-$(head -c 16 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')}"; bash .atlas/palworld.sh config; bash .atlas/palworld.sh console <&0 & ./Pal/Binaries/Linux/PalServer-Linux-Shipping Pal -port={{SERVER_PORT}} -queryport={{QUERY_PORT}} -players={{MAX_PLAYERS}} -useperfthreads -NoAsyncLoadingThread -UseMultithreadForDS $( [[ "${PUBLIC_LOBBY}" =~ ^(1|true)$ ]] && printf %s "-publiclobby -publicport={{SERVER_PORT}}" ) $( [ -n "${PUBLIC_IP}" ] && printf %s "-publicip=${PUBLIC_IP}" )

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Short description shown in the server list.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for an open server.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for in-game admin commands (/AdminPassword) and for RCON. When empty, a random one is used for each run, so the console and a clean stop still work but nobody can log in as an admin.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Most players that can be connected at once (1-32).

variables.name: Community Server
variables.description: List the server in the in-game community server browser.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Address announced to the community server browser. Leave empty to let the server detect it.

variables.name: REST API Port
variables.description: Port of the server's REST API. It is only used inside the container, to save and shut down cleanly, and is not published.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. The installer and the update check on start both use it.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Check Steam for a game update every time the server starts.
